import.itemsIntro: Download the template, fill it with the new items and their prices, then choose the file and check it before importing.
import.pricesIntro: Download the template and fill in each item's code and its new price. A new price applies to new sales only.

detail.select: Choose an item in the list to see its details.
detail.inactive: This item is deactivated: it is hidden from the POS and from search.
detail.kitCostUnknown: Unknown: some components have no purchase price

barcodes.hint: A pack barcode scans several units at once: write how many units each scan counts.

components.hint: What one kit is made of: stock items and services, never another kit.
components.search: Search for an item to add

deactivate.title: Deactivate item
deactivate.explanation: Items are never deleted, because their movements and invoices must be kept. Deactivating hides the item from the POS and search; you can reactivate it.

dialog.fixErrors: Correct the marked fields, then save.
dialog.codeHint: Suggested from the category; it can be changed only before the first save.
dialog.codeFixed: The code never changes after the item is created.
dialog.priceLocked: Changing the price needs the "Manage prices" permission.
dialog.typeFixedOther: This item is in use, so its type can no longer change.

typeFixed.kit_component: This item is part of a kit, so its type can no longer change.
typeFixed.kit_contents: This kit has components, so its type can no longer change.

errors.code: A code uses English letters, digits and . _ - only, up to 32 characters.
errors.price: Write a valid price with at most 4 decimals, e.g. 12.50
errors.priceLocked: An item for sale needs a price, and setting it needs the "Manage prices" permission. Turn off "For sale" or ask someone who has the permission.
errors.barcode: A barcode is 3 to 64 English letters or digits.
errors.perScan: The quantity per scan must be a number above zero.
errors.components: Add at least one component to the kit.
errors.quantity: Each component's quantity must be a number above zero.

dialog.costHint: Without VAT, up to 4 decimals, e.g. 62.50. Only the owner sees it.
dialog.kitCost: A kit's cost is worked out from its components; it is not typed here.
dialog.openingQtyHint: In {unit}. Saved as this item's opening stock, with the item.
dialog.stockNote: Quantity corrected in the item window
dialog.stockEditHint: In {unit}. A change is saved as a stock adjustment (data correction).

stock.title: Stock
stock.calculated: Stock is calculated from movements and never edited by hand.

adjust.title: Stock adjustment
adjust.unitCostHint: Leave it empty to use the average cost.
adjust.explain: The stock is never edited directly: a numbered adjustment is recorded and the stock is calculated from it.
adjust.approvalExplain: This adjustment is worth more than the limit and needs a supervisor's approval.

errors.quantity: Write a valid quantity above zero.
errors.noDifference: The counted quantity equals the system quantity: there is nothing to adjust.

labels.title: Barcode labels
labels.noSizes: No label sizes are active. Add them in Settings → Lists.
labels.preview: Preview at twice the size: exactly the dots that will print
labels.addEnglish: Add English name if it fits

refused.too_small: This label size is too small for the name, the barcode and the price. Choose a bigger size or turn the price off.
refused.barcode_too_long: This code is too long for a barcode on this label size. Choose a wider size.

labels.sent: {count} label(s) sent to the label printer.

problem.browser: Printing works in the Windows app only.
problem.no_printer: No label printer is set on this PC (Settings → Devices).
problem.failed: The label printer did not respond. Check that it is on, connected and has labels.
problem.no_drawer: The label printer has no cash drawer.

labels.dialogNote: No label printer is set on this PC: the print dialog opens. Choose the label printer there, size 100%.
labels.sheetNote: A4 sheets print through the print dialog, at 100% size.
